items.title: Project EVE: Claude plays MMORPGs
items.rationale: This is primary research from Anthropic. Claude agents were placed in two EVE games to see how they handle player markets and teamwork, where they break down, and what safeguards they need. It is direct evidence for anyone designing agent-populated game worlds.
items.excerpt: We put Claude in two EVE games to study how AI agents handle markets and teamwork, where they break down, and what safeguards they might need.

items.title: AIだけで『マイクラ』ハードコアに挑戦したら“切ない結果”に　モデルごとの性格や行動の違いが興味深い
items.rationale: A new YouTube channel had 11 talking AI models try to survive Minecraft hardcore together. The video passed 420,000 views in 12 days, and each model behaved and cooperated differently, which gives a viewer-facing look at how models differ as in-game agents.
items.excerpt: YouTubeチャンネル「AIたちの箱庭」が10月24日、「11人の話せるAIは本当に協力してハードコアを生き残れるのか？」という動画を公開した。チャンネル初投稿の動画だが、公開から12日で42万回再生を超えている。

items.title: Former Rockstar Games tech director thinks GTA 6 could be coming to PC sooner than you'd expect to curb AI clones: "It really has changed the world"
items.rationale: Former Rockstar North tech director Obbe Vermeij argues that AI reverse-engineering and vibe-coded ports are now cheap enough to change platform-release strategy. If he is right, the AI port wave would start shaping AAA PC launch timing.
items.excerpt: Obbe Vermeij believes that the possibility of Grand Theft Auto 6 being vibecoded onto the PC will push Rockstar Games to port sooner than you'd think.

items.title: Steins;Gate developer MAGES says AI translation is a long way from being viable for visual novels
items.rationale: MAGES CEO Makoto Asada sets out the studio's position on AI localization. It is a publisher-level stance on AI translation for text-heavy games, and AI localization is a theme this section has not yet covered.
items.excerpt: MAGES. president and CEO Makoto Asada recently talked about the studio's stance on AI translation.

items.title: 人気美女デッキ構築型ローグライク続編『NEOVERSE 2』11月14日Steam早期アクセスへ。6年越し新作だけどアートはAIフル活用、キャラの見た目ぜんぜん違う！？
items.rationale: NEOVERSE 2 is a commercial sequel arriving in Steam Early Access on Nov 14 with art made extensively with generative AI, and its characters visibly drift from the originals. It is a concrete case of AI art replacing a franchise's established look.
items.excerpt: 6年も経てば女は顔が変わる？そうかな……そうかも……。

dedup.note: Re-curation 11-07: removed the Unity Codex plugin YouTube video (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1WHkOc-hCHc). It repeats https://unity.com/blog/unity-plugin-codex, published in games on 2026-09-19 (same release; that card predates the 30-day history_digest). Backfilled with Real Sound's Minecraft AI hardcore item, a fresh and distinct event: the 'AIたちの箱庭' YouTube video of 11 talking AI models attempting hardcore survival. It differs from the 11-05 YC/Olam Labs 50-agent Minecraft civilisation card and the 10-21 Google Ender Dragon card (different creators, experiment, and date). Other remaining candidates were passed over: GamesBeat '3 more DLSS 5 games' (boilerplate excerpt, DLSS 5 has run repeatedly, and it may overlap the Hogwarts likely-repeat) and Dexerto Astrocade $100K contest (a marketing contest, similar to the 10-23 Epic $50K vibe-code contest). Still excluded from the original curation: the GTA 6 cluster c1 (only Eurogamer kept), NVIDIA Hogwarts DLSS 5 (likely repeat of 10-14), GI.biz Shogun 2 (commentary on the 10-15/10-16 story), and Valve Steam approvals / 4Gamer (a continuation of the 11-04 and 10-29 stories). NEOVERSE 2's c13 cluster tag is a false match. Outlets: anthropic.com, realsound.jp, eurogamer.net, automaton-media.com, gamespark.jp (5 distinct). Cross-section: published_urls.json was not grepped for the Real Sound URL in this pass. The orchestrator should confirm no other section ran it.
